title: Ponniyin Selvan
subtitle: The Son of the Kaveri
summary: Set in the 10th century during the zenith of the Chola dynasty, Ponniyin Selvan follows the young warrior Vandiyathevan as he carries a secret message through a kingdom seething with conspiracy. From the grand courts of Thanjavur to the shores of Lanka, political intrigue, forbidden romance, and dynastic ambition collide in Kalki Krishnamurthy's greatest Tamil novel — a sweeping epic of loyalty, betrayal, and the destiny of an empire.
